regime_context: The TSX exhibits broad eligibility (88%) with Base Metals & Copper as the lead theme, supported by full breadth and moderate durability. The absolute-trend gate historically reduces drawdowns in Canada, so staying in eligible themes is a tested risk-control framework. No extreme crowding or one-narrative dominance; the rotation margin to Gold Miners is healthy but not directional.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff to Gold Miners if its score sustainably overtakes Base Metals & Copper and the rotation margin flips positive for at least 5 consecutive days; until then, treat as a watch, not a call.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals leads with the highest momentum rank, full breadth (1.0), and durability above 0.7, while the absolute-trend gate eligibility (gate_helps true) suggests the trend-following regime is historically risk-mitigating in Canada. This supports a directional overweight relative to the benchmark, focusing on the tested risk-control edge.
theses.dissent: The Hurst tag is mixed, indicating the trend may be fragile; momentum rank-IC is ~0, so outperformance is not forecastable; a sharp rotation into financials or defensives could unwind the metals rally quickly.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners show stronger durability (0.79) and a trend Hurst tag, alongside full breadth and no crowding, while remaining eligible under the validated trend-gate. This configuration aligns with the risk-control framework, favoring an overweight lean.
theses.dissent: Score is well below Base Metals; gold price sensitivity could trigger sharp reversals unrelated to TSX relative momentum. The detector provides no return forecasting edge, only risk-control.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Despite being eligible, Technology ranks near the bottom (score -0.77), is flagged as crowded, and its durability (0.71) may reflect a persistent downtrend. Underweighting relative to benchmark aligns with the trend-following discipline and crowding caution.
theses.dissent: Crowding is not a sell signal; a short-squeeze or thematic rotation could lift Tech sharply. The absolute-trend gate may keep it eligible, meaning drawdown risk is not necessarily elevated in the past.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days
